chapter two

Finch 我们关系的转折点

And we are back here, baby. What are we doing right now? Are we busy catching the TTC? Or maybe we had lots of time looking around? It's sad that the store is no longer there... I'm not even sure if we had ordered in the store. If we can let's take a photo in the new building shall we?

Oh also, do you remember the snow? The slushy weather was truly a mood.

Let's come back again during the winter, just this time you'll be with me and your hands in mine.

我猜你一定不知道，我们并肩在雪中走的时候,
我有多想上去牵住你的手，放进我的口袋里。

This was the first time we had a long conversation in person about our relation-pre-ship, and a hug.

In our relation-pre-ship, this was known as:
THE BIG SCARY SAD CRYING TURNING POINT THAT TURNED OUT OKAY.

嗯，也是回暖的关键转折点

chapter three

BBQ / Concert Night 第一场演唱会

我们第一场一起看的演唱会。

你扛着困意陪我来吃烧烤，
还遇见了上台的那个小姐姐，
and 最最好吃的酸奶皮子。

在那以后，没有遇见 any 酸奶 that's remotely comparable.

Maybe... it's the experience with you
that made it so tasteful~

Do you still remember the events of that day?

1me missing 18258125 exits
2见证求婚
3陶吉吉的演唱会
4随机进了一家饭店
5Pizza
6Poopoo falling asleep

Well, this is how I remember it: 

We ate pizza before getting there, and I drove instead of taking the TTC(to this day I do not know if it's a good or bad thing, had we taken the TTC maybe you wouldn't have had to wait for so long to go to the washroom. 

Then I missed way too many exists, making my poor poopoo suffer. I apologize here again. 

我不知道为什么当时我好像没道歉 想想挺蠢的。

Then we finally arrived at the concert. After a long and eventful concert I was hungry again so I asked you if you can go eat barbeque with me. To which you said yes. The eating stuff we all know. It's the way back, where you fell asleep that I want to talk to you the most about. 

开着开着，你的头就慢慢地、慢慢地向窗边侧过去。
车子时不时左晃一下，右晃一下，你也跟着轻轻地晃。明明只是很普通的一段路，一段我们走过很多次很多次的路（bathurst）可是我到现在都还记得特别清楚那个瞬间。车里放着《追光者》，窗外的路灯一闪一闪地从你脸上划过，偶尔一辆超速了不知道多少的车飞驰而过。你，就这样安安静静的坐在我旁边。

那一刻，真的就感觉全世界只剩你和我。

我偷偷看了你好几次，满脑子都是：嗯我宝真漂亮真可爱。睡着了的样子也是这样的可爱，小脸嘟嘟的，软软的。我当时就在想，如果时间可以停下来就好了。就这样，永远永远。

不用分开，不用回家，也不用想之后会发生什么。Just some good music, and a bumpy car ride, with you right besides me, there's nothing more I could possibly ask for.

后来我们还是到家了。你睡眼朦胧地醒过来，整个人还有点迷迷糊糊的，可是还是记得转过来抱我一下。那个拥抱软软的、香香的，你嘴里还小声嘟囔了几句。

我看着你走进去的时候，心里其实特别开心，也特别幸福。

It wasn't anything grand, it wasn't something so majestic like the concert or an major event. 只是你在我旁边睡了一路，醒来之后给了我一个抱抱， that's it, that's all.
